lines.text: This is Pitchlight: explainable match intelligence from synthetic football events, live on Azure.
Open the match, and events stream in, each one validated as it arrives.
Every moment explains why it matters, with the build-up and the evidence behind it.
Ask anything, in seven languages. A Foundry agent calls Pitchlight's own MCP tools.
The viewer sees the tool's verified answer, never the model's own text.
A Container Apps job streams the match through Event Hubs, and every event is validated live.
It even recovers passes and goals from broadcast video, scored against ground truth.
The pass network shows who passes to whom, and which lanes move the ball forward.
Show change compares the last fifteen minutes with the fifteen before.
After each substitution, it compares before and after, and never claims a cause.
Recaps start with a researcher agent. It investigates through MCP and chooses the angle.
Writer agents draft the recap, and a fact checker extracts every statement.
Code verifies each one. Anything unsupported is never published.
The same verified facts become broadcast overlays, here in Arabic, right to left.
Measured, not claimed: live recaps in seven languages, and zero errors under load.
Pitchlight. Microsoft Foundry, Agent Framework, MCP, and Azure Container Apps.
